7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve: Price, Calories & Recipe

A medium Frosted Cookie Breve is about $5.25, with 450 calories, 120 mg of caffeine and 29 g of sugar. Every number here comes from 7 Brew's own published nutrition guide, broken out by size and preparation.

Frosted Cookie Breve allergens

7 Brew's published allergen guide lists Milk for the Frosted Cookie Breve. Adding a milk, syrup or topping changes this, and every drink is made on shared equipment, so cross-contact is possible.

If you are ordering around an allergy, check the full allergen and dietary guide and confirm at the window.

How to order a Frosted Cookie Breve

Ask for it by name — it is on the standard board at every 7 Brew, so no special script is needed. Say the size first, then the drink: "Can I get a medium Frosted Cookie Breve?"

Worth knowing before you order: the base is customisable. You can swap milk, ask for sugar-free syrups, change the sweetness level, or have most drinks made iced, hot or blended as a frozen chiller where the menu allows. Ordering through the app earns 100 rewards points either way.

Make a Frosted Cookie at Home (Copycat Recipe)

Three syrups share the work here, and the order matters less than the balance: cupcake up front for the frosting flavor, Irish cream for depth, salted caramel to anchor it. All three are standard coffee syrups, and the Irish cream is the non-alcoholic syrup kind.

For one medium iced Frosted Cookie (24 oz cup)

  • 2 shots of espresso (about 2 oz), hot
  • 1 oz cupcake syrup
  • 1/2 oz Irish cream syrup
  • 1/2 oz salted caramel syrup
  • About 8 oz half-and-half
  • A full cup of ice
  1. Pour the three syrups into the cup.
  2. Add the hot espresso and stir.
  3. Fill the cup with ice, then pour the half-and-half over the top.
  4. Stir once and drink. Cold foam and a caramel drizzle is the brewista-style finish fans post.

Hot version: steam the half-and-half, skip the ice, same syrups and shots. Lighter version: there is no official sugar-free Frosted Cookie, so order or make it half sweet. No espresso machine? Use 2 oz of very strong coffee.

7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve FAQ

How many calories are in a 7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve?

A medium iced Frosted Cookie Breve has 450 calories. A small has 290 and a large 530, according to 7 Brew's nutrition guide.

How much caffeine is in a 7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve?

About 120 mg in a medium. Small is 120 mg and large is 240 mg.

How much does a 7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve cost?

Roughly $4.50 for a small, $5.25 for a medium and $6.25 for a large. Prices are our estimates and vary by stand — every 7 Brew is independently owned.

How much sugar is in a 7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve?

29 g in a medium.

What is in a 7 Brew Frosted Cookie Breve?

Cupcake, Irish cream and salted caramel syrups with espresso in a half-and-half breve base. The cupcake brings the vanilla-frosting note, the Irish cream adds warmth underneath, and the salted caramel keeps it from going flat sweet. It tastes like a frosted sugar cookie, not a chocolate cookie.

Frosted Cookie or Cookie Butter: what is the difference?

Different flavors that search results keep mixing up. Frosted Cookie is cupcake, Irish cream and salted caramel: 450 calories and 29 g of sugar in a medium iced. Cookie Butter is toasted marshmallow, hazelnut and white chocolate: 580 calories and 67 g of sugar. The Frosted Cookie is the lighter, frosting-style drink. The Cookie Butter is the richer, spiced-cookie one.

Is there a sugar-free Frosted Cookie Breve?

Not officially. 7 Brew publishes no sugar-free version of this drink and no sugar-free numbers for it, whatever some fan pages claim about sugar-free syrups. The reliable lighter order is half sweet or quarter sweet. The drinks that do come sugar-free, all 43 of them, are compared on our sugar-free page.

Is the Frosted Cookie a secret menu drink?

Fans call it one, but it is listed on 7 Brew's official menu and carries full rows in the current nutrition guide (October 2026). Order it by name at any stand.

How do I make a Frosted Cookie Breve at home?

For a medium iced: 1 oz cupcake syrup, 1/2 oz Irish cream syrup and 1/2 oz salted caramel syrup, 2 shots of espresso, and about 8 oz of half-and-half over ice. The full copycat recipe is in the recipe section on this page.
